title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: wellness-challenge participation and biometric screening by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's tier basis for enrolling employees in chain-wide wellness challenges, whether a complimentary biometric screening is included, and how many such screenings are included per year.

| Tier | Chain-wide wellness challenge participation | Complimentary biometric screening included | Screenings included per year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | Yes | No | 0 |
| Small Business Partner | Yes | No | 0 |
| Mid-Market Partner | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Enterprise Partner | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Municipal Partner | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Nonprofit Partner | Yes | No | 0 |

Where biometric screening is not included for a tier, no annual screening frequency applies.
